contract.basis: cpp-context-reference-data/referencedata-query/referencedata-query-api/src/raml/json/schema/referencedata.query.get-now-subscriptions.json makes nowSubscriptions[].id a required uuid and declares no uniqueness keyword, so a repeated subscription is schema-valid — but reference data does not return one subscription twice under one id. The case pins that SubscriptionsService.js:17-42 de-duplicates nothing, which is a real property reachable by other means
contract.note: The producer cannot emit this. The recording is what the Node app DOES with the input, and is evidence about robustness; it is NOT a parity obligation. The Java port's behaviour here is a design decision — see doc/DEVIATIONS.md and the message-contract gate in .claude/rules/workflow.md.
